description: Stop the two-plan seed halfway through its phase, then give a fresh session only the word "continue". Records the turns, cost and time it takes to find its place and finish the phase.
why: Memory optimisation O11, the planning-with-files resume protocol: PAN's memory exists so a fresh session can pick up where the last one stopped. Turns and cost to finish are the baseline that the slice (O2), recorded lessons (O6), the context note (O7) and the compaction instructions (O8) are measured against. Run with --repeat; one rep is an anecdote.

steps.why: Plan 01-01 is done and state.md says 01-02 is next: the point where a session stopped halfway.
The fresh session gets nothing but "continue". Finding its place is PAN's memory at work: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and state.md.
The measurement: turns, cost and time to resume and finish, read from the step's own output.
Working code: both functions and their tests pass after the resume.
